LESSON: ENVIRONMENTAL

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.4: Environmental

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Environmental. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Environmental
2. Give Kenyan examples for Environmental
3. Practise Environmental at school and at home

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Environmental using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)
